$comment: Picture book template (phase 7), from the owner's Children's Bedtime Story Writer and Kids' Bedtime Story & Video Script Generator drafts. Channel-specific calls to action from the drafts are replaced by an optional {cta} the owner fills. source: profile | owner | ai | app.
name: Picture Book (Bedtime Story)

wordLimit.note: Under 1,000 words in total story text (drafts).

newWord.rule: One key word to learn (for example Brave, Grateful, Courageous), used naturally at least three times and explained in words a small child understands. If the word is unusual (Xenial, Zealous), give its meaning in the story.

storyRules.mainCharacter: A friendly main character: an animal, a gentle magical creature or a kind child.
storyRules.conflict: A gentle, small, non-scary problem that is solved kindly and easily.
storyRules.message: One positive message: kindness, courage, sharing, friendship, patience, gratitude.
storyRules.ending: Happy and soothing, so the child feels safe and relaxed.

goodnightMessage.rule: Optional short goodnight message a parent can say after the story.

storyRules.titleStyle: Cute and catchy, with alliteration, rhyme or rhythm (for example 'Pip the Penguin's Persistent Path').
language: Simple repeated dialogue children can join in with
Occasional gentle rhyme or rhythm, never forced
Easy similes ('soft as a bunny's ear')
Sensory details: soft textures, comforting sounds, warm light
forbidden: danger, injury or illness shown in a frightening way
unsafe behaviour presented as fine (for example going off alone)
storyRules.safetyCheck: Every story is checked twice against the forbidden list: once by the writer prompt before it answers, once by checks.claims in children mode.

cta.rule: Optional closing line for a video or channel, supplied by the owner (the drafts used a channel follow request). Never added to the printed book unless the owner turns it on.

spreads.artStyleDefault: Bright, soft 3D animated look with rounded shapes and warm light, not imitating any named studio.
spreads.characterSheet: One character description prompt reused in every scene prompt for consistency.

print.pageCountNote: Page limits come from paperback.trimAndPages.colour for the chosen ink and trim; standard colour has a higher minimum than premium colour, so short picture books use premium colour. 12 spreads plus front and back matter fits a 32-page layout.
print.spineText: Picture books are usually shorter than the spine-text minimum in paperback.spine.textMinPages, so they have no spine text.

sections.title: Today's New Word
sections.content: The new word and a one-line child-friendly meaning.

sections.title: New Words
sections.content: The new words introduced in the story, each with a child-friendly meaning, checked by the owner. Early readers list it.

publishing.content: Children mode: also lists anything that breaks the forbidden list.

marketing.rule: Parent audience; no claims about learning outcomes.

derivedFrom: draft: Kids' Bedtime Story & Video Script Generator (Star Rhymes TV)
